'''Nico Kreidl''' (also published as '''Nico Johannes Kreidl''' and '''Nico Kreidel''') played a constructed list at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2). Nico Kreidl also played the [[2019 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ 2019 World Championship], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013160304/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2019-worlds.html Internet Archive]</ref> Nico Kreidl also played at [[December 2001 Mainz tournament]] on 9 December 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]], according to Vjeko Keskic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ 09-12-2001-mainz-germany], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 4 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
